Bash(.venv/bin/python -c "
from scrapers.ziprecruiter import scrape_listings
jobs = scrape_listings\('cybersecurity intern', 'United States', max_pages=1\)
print\(f'Total jobs found: {len\(jobs\)}'\)
for j in jobs[:5]:
    print\(f'  {j[\\"title\\"]} @ {j[\\"company\\"]}'\)
    print\(f'  URL: {j[\\"url\\"]}'\)
    print\(\)
if not jobs:
    print\('No jobs returned — cards may not have matched the selector.'\)
")
